literal_statement_defect: A rational affine line {(x,1):x in R} has no vertices. Its horizontal recession rays cannot generate it without a base point. Arbitrary polyhedra with lineality are therefore not generated by their actual vertices plus recession rays.
correct_form: A nonempty rational polyhedron is the convex hull of finitely many rational GENERATING POINTS plus a finitely generated rational recession cone, including opposite generators for lineality. Actual vertices may be used after quotienting lineality and rationally lifting quotient vertices, or on a pointed rational refinement.
existing_proof_LF62: The unchanged homogenization proof already produces rational points rather than original vertices; its pointed coordinate refinement or lineality quotient supplies the qualified vertex applications.
actual_trace_application: The entire-trace construction explicitly takes a pointed rational carrier before appending all trace vertices. This correction does not refute that construction; it does not fill the remaining whole-grant/source audit gaps.
